Required findings: Pre‑ and post‑test genetic counseling by an appropriate provider
No prior full‑sequence BRCA testing, no prior deletion/duplication analysis, and no prior Ashkenazi founder mutation testing
Member is 18 years of age or older

Either (a) Diagnostic testing: Ashkenazi Jewish descent plus a personal diagnosis of epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, primary peritoneal cancer, breast cancer (any age, male or female), exocrine pancreatic cancer, or confirmed prostate cancer (any age); OR (b) Predisposition testing: Ashkenazi Jewish descent plus a first‑ or second‑degree relative of Ashkenazi descent who meets any of the diagnostic criteria, the affected relative is unavailable for testing, and a close blood relative (1st‑3rd degree) with a known Ashkenazi founder BRCA mutation exists
Testing performed by a qualified laboratory

Required findings: Pre‑ and post‑test genetic counseling by an appropriate provider
No prior full‑sequence BRCA1/2 testing and no mutation identified by alternate methods if previously performed
If a familial mutation is known, that mutation does not fully explain the testing indication
Member is 18 years of age or older

Member meets at least one of the following diagnostic or personal/family‑history criteria: diagnostic criteria for Ashkenazi founder testing without prior founder testing; female breast cancer diagnosed ≤ 50 years; two or more primary breast cancers at any age; triple‑negative breast cancer at any age; male breast cancer at any age; epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer at any age; prostate cancer with metastatic disease, intraductal/cribriform histology, high‑risk or very‑high‑risk per NCCN; exocrine pancreatic cancer; initial breast cancer plus a close relative with breast cancer ≤ 50 years, ovarian/fallopian tube/peritoneal cancer at any age, or a relative with triple‑negative breast cancer; additional family‑history combinations enumerated in the policy
Testing performed by a qualified laboratory
